findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_public_overview, explore_sports_facilities, check_disposal, get_place · Public sink: get_place · Destructive: check_disposal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_public_overview, explore_sports_facilities, check_disposal, get_place · Public sink: get_place · Destructive: check_disposal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
